newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia central bank sells HRK 166 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia central bank sells HRK 166 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 166 million kuna worth of 35- and 91-day bills at a regular auction on Wednesday, down from 274.5 million kuna last week.
The rates were flat at 8.0 and 9.5 percent, as the bank accepted bids by commercial banks for 139 and 27 million kuna liquidity bills respectively.
They compared with 11 percent paid lately for 35-day treasury bills of the Finance Ministry and 13 percent for its 91-day T-bills.
The central bank's 182-day paper, last issued three months ago, again failed to attract interest from investors.
